pr_title: Adds buttons contrast on primary buttons
pr_body: ## What kind of change does this PR introduce? Increase contrast on primary buttons ## What is the current behavior? ## What is the new behavior? ## Additional context Fixes https://github.com/supabase/supabase/issues/329 This solution adds a text shadow to the buttons (rather than using black text). This is my preferred approach - I originally tried the black text and decided it doesn't quite look right. This new change makes the branding site consistent with the docs and dashboard

issue_context.title: Insufficient Contrast of the Buttons on the Website
issue_context.body: # Feature request I would suggest using very dark or black text on your primary buttons, as opposed to white text. ## Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe. Yes, button background do not have sufficient contrast with the button text. ## Describe the solution you'd like Having black or very dark (matching your background) text on these buttons would not only solve this problem but it would also be inline with the theme of the website:
